epics.name: Reactivation V2 — Sales UAT
epics.summary: Focused UAT for Reactivation V2. Same 6 missions for every tester. Hands-on in Staging; record Pass/Fail here. Prefer different records per tester so you don't collide.

testerPlan.note: All testers run missions 1–6. Set your Tester name before saving. Export JSON when done and send to the coordinator. ~60–90 minutes.

missions.name: 1. Reactivate one archived location → Lead
missions.goal: From an archived Account, create a prefilled reactivation Lead that looks correct for Sales.
missions.doneWhen: A reactivation Lead exists, linked to the Account, with expected prefilled fields; Account stays archived.
steps: Log in to Staging as a Sales user (or Login As).
Open an archived (deleted) merchant Account in your country.
Use the Reactivate action to create a reactivation Lead.
Confirm LeadSource = Reactivation and Source Account is set.
Confirm key merchant fields are prefilled and usable.
Paste Lead URL in Evidence URL.

missions.name: 2. Churn context visible on Lead (and Opp if available)
missions.goal: See churn date, reason, sub-reason, and AM commentary as a clear read-only section — not buried in fields.
missions.doneWhen: Churn Context section is visible when context exists; hidden when empty; read-only.
steps: Open a reactivation Lead that should have churn context.
Confirm the Churn Context section shows date, reason, sub-reason (if any), commentary.
Confirm you cannot edit it.
If Lead→Opp conversion is available in Staging, confirm the section also appears on the Opp.
Paste record URL(s) in Evidence URL.

missions.name: 3. Latest asset visible on Lead/Opp
missions.goal: See the merchant's latest asset so Sales does not ship duplicate hardware.
missions.doneWhen: Latest asset info is visible on the reactivation Lead (and Opp if converted).
steps: Open a reactivation Lead for a merchant that has assets in Staging.
Confirm latest asset information is shown on the page.
If an Opp exists from conversion, confirm the same visibility there.
Paste record URL in Evidence URL.

missions.name: 4. Brand bulk reactivation
missions.goal: From Brand health, reactivate multiple eligible locations and skip ones already in flight.
missions.doneWhen: Selected locations get reactivation Leads; already-in-flight rows are not selectable / not duplicated.
steps: Open a Brand with several archived locations in Staging.
Use Brand-level Reactivate / reactivation UI.
Select multiple eligible locations and submit.
Confirm new Leads were created for selected locations.
Confirm locations that already have an open reactivation Lead are skipped / not duplicated.
Paste Brand + sample Lead URLs in Evidence URL.

missions.name: 5. Group bulk reactivation
missions.goal: From Group health, reactivate across the Group the same way as Brand.
missions.doneWhen: Group-level reactivation creates Leads for selected eligible locations and respects already-in-flight.
steps: Open a Group with archived locations in Staging.
Use Group-level Reactivate / reactivation UI.
Select eligible locations and submit.
Confirm Leads created and no duplicates for already-in-flight locations.
Paste Group + sample Lead URLs in Evidence URL.

missions.name: 6. Warn, then auto-close untouched reactivation Opp
missions.goal: Inactive reactivation Opportunities get a warning, then auto-close as Lost with the right loss reason — never if Won.
missions.doneWhen: You can point to a warning case and an auto-closed Lost case; a Won Opp is not auto-closed.
steps: Use prepared Staging Opps (or ask coordinator for test Opps) past warning / auto-close thresholds.
Confirm warning notification for the warning-threshold Opp.
Confirm auto-close Lost with loss reason like 'Reactivation not done in time' for the close-threshold Opp.
Confirm a Won reactivation Opp is left alone.
Paste Opp URLs in Evidence URL.
